Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 13
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly treated the “Origin: Paris, France” field on Wikipedia as the performer’s birthplace and proposed using it as the answer, despite the article text already stating Nekfeu “was born in La Trinité” (Alpes-Maritimes, France). This conflation of “origin” with “born” led to the wrong birthplace.
